name: SPB Championship 2017

information: Registration will be closed on October, 22 or when we reach 200 competitors. Registration fee is 250 RUB for any 3 events. Each next event is +10 RUB. Registartion fee contains extra 50 RUB if you pay on competition's day at the venue. Please see the website for more information.
